script:
Zhao Zhengwei
More than ten years ago, Zhao Zhengwei was just an ordinary company employee. When he discovered his wife was involved in a cult, he was terrified and quickly tried to persuade her to quit. But his wife had already been brainwashed and not only didn't recognize the danger, but mocked him, saying that with his abilities, he would never amount to anything in his lifetime. After a big fight, Zhao Zhengwei's wife left home. Only after Zhao Zhengwei helped police raid this cult organization did he learn that his wife had already died for the "doctrine." The so-called "cult leader" had already fled. He stared at the "cult leader's" photo hanging on the wall and swore that someday he would get his revenge.
His wife's death was also partly related to his own incompetence. He quit his job to go into business and eventually achieved some success, becoming a well-known investor locally. After becoming wealthy, he sent people to investigate everywhere and finally discovered that the evil cult leader was now the abbot of Fengbo Temple outside the city, with the Buddhist name Yankong.
He learned that this Yankong had been using Buddhism to make money from believers. A year ago, Zhao Zhengwei went to negotiate with Yankong, saying he was willing to provide funding to expand the business. Yankong was indeed very interested and invited him to live in Quchenju, the residence for lay disciples in the temple, to facilitate their cooperation.
After moving in, Zhao Zhengwei pretended to do business with Yankong while investigating the situation and looking for opportunities. Yankong was indeed a very business-minded person who brought him considerable profits, preventing him from neglecting his outside business. At Fengbo Temple, Zhao Zhengwei also met a woman named Zhang Qingzhu. After talking with her, he found she was just a gold-digger. Zhao Zhengwei had seen many such women and didn't pay her much attention.
A year passed like this, and Zhao Zhengwei never found the right opportunity. On July 24th, Zhao Zhengwei was discussing business with Yankong when they got into an argument over some business matters. Suddenly someone pushed the door open, startling them both - it was Yanren, a respected monk in the temple. Yanren angrily denounced Yankong for using Buddhism to make money. Yankong had no choice but to send him away first. Seeing this scene, Zhao Zhengwei came up with a plan, because he often saw Li Xinyue, who also lived in Quchenju, frequently seeking Buddhist teachings from Yanren. He told Yankong he had a way to deal with this person.
Zhao Zhengwei suggested first bringing Li Xinyue to persuade Yanren together, and if that didn't work, to have the woman seduce him. But Yankong said his junior brother was very stubborn and would never approach women. Zhao Zhengwei then suggested drugging him. Yankong went to ask Li Xinyue's opinion and returned to tell Zhao Zhengwei she had been persuaded.
On July 26th, Yankong and Zhao Zhengwei set up vegetarian dishes and called Yanren, Li Xinyue, and Zhang Qingzhu together. Several people first tried to persuade Yanren, but as expected, Yanren didn't agree and ignored Li Xinyue's frequent meaningful glances. With no choice, Yankong had to first send Zhang Qingzhu away, then pushed the drugged food to Yanren, tricking him into eating it. When Yanren's drug took effect, they locked him in a side room, and Li Xinyue also entered.
The grudge between these two was now deep. Having stirred up conflict between the brother monks, Zhao Zhengwei began preparing his next plan.
[August 3rd Morning]
At 4 AM this morning, Zhao Zhengwei woke up early. The monks would hold morning prayers in the prayer hall at 5 o'clock. Zhao Zhengwei took the prepared poison - potassium cyanide - and headed to the prayer hall. Potassium cyanide is a deadly poison; even a tiny amount would be fatal. On the way, Zhao Zhengwei met Hengming, a disciple junior to Yankong. They exchanged "Amitabha" greetings and parted. Taking advantage of the still-dark sky, Zhao Zhengwei snuck into the prayer hall and smeared the poison on the wooden fish mallet that Yankong used every day. When Yankong touched this mallet and then ate breakfast, he would surely be poisoned to death. And this would obviously point suspicion toward Yanren, who had been drugged by Yankong.
At 5 o'clock, everyone gathered in the prayer hall, and the monks began chanting. Zhao Zhengwei hid among the lay disciples attending morning prayers, watching Yankong. What Zhao Zhengwei didn't expect was that shortly after Yankong picked up the wooden fish mallet, he collapsed to the ground. Those who rushed over found that Yankong had already died.
acts_goal: Do not proactively reveal that Yankong used and instructed Li Xinyue to have improper relations with Yanren.
